whatsNew.title: What's New in TeleDrive
features: Zero-Knowledge Encryption (TDE1) — Client-side AES-256-GCM chunk encryption with recovery key & instant block seeking
Resumable >2/4 GB Multi-Segment Transfers — Checkpoint resume, auto-splitting & SHA-256 zero-upload deduplication
Instant Cold Boot & 3x Pipelined Streaming — Non-blocking IndexedDB cache, Catalog v3 & parallel MTProto downloads
Universal Previews & Grid Thumbnails — Native DOCX, ODT, RTF, EPUB, XLSX/ODS, PPTX/ODP, ZIP/TAR, HTML & PDF/video thumbnails
Refined Cross-Platform Sync — Hardened Tauri v2 performance & full parity across all 11 languages
